High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Sharmila Sharma - Advocate for the petitioner [P-2].
 Shri Amit Bhatia - Government Advocate for the responde
I.A. No.7964/2024 for urgent hearing and I.A. No.7965/2025 for urgent hearing during vacation are taken up.
On due consideration, applications are allowed.

Heard on I.A.No.7963/2025, first application under Section 430 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (equivalent to Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C.) for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the appellant no.1- Ashat @ Ashay.
The appellant has been convicted for offence under Sections 366-A and 376-D of IPC and sentenced to undergo 3 years R.I with fine of Rs.500/-, 20 years R.I. with fine of Rs.5,000/- respectively with default stipulations.
Learned counsel for the appellant no.1 submits that on 23.05.2025 the mother of appellant no.1 has died and there is no one in the family to perform the last rituals/rites.

She further submits that the factum of death of the mother of appellant no.1 is evident from the receipt of Mukti Dham which is filed alongwith the application and prays for grant of temporary suspension.
Learned Government Advocate appearing on behalf of respondent/State submits that the factum of death of the mother of appellant no.1 has not been verified.
He further submits that report is still awaited.

Considering the fact that mother of appellant no.1 has died on 23.05.2025, 2 CRA-2298-2024 we are inclined to allow the present application (I.A.No.7963/2025) subject to the verification of the factum of death of mother of appellant no.1.
State is directed to verify the same and in case the same is found incorrect, State is directed to intimate the same to the trial Court on or before 04.06.2025.

In the absence of any verification report or any negative report, trial Court will release the appellant no.1 on temporary bail for a period of 15 days and his jail sentence shall be temporarily suspended Akshat @ Akshay vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35111032/

He will surrender immediately before the trial Court on the 16th day of his release.
In case, the appellant no.1 does not surrender, the trial Court shall be free to take action for taking him into custody, in accordance with law.
Copy of this order be forwarded to the trial Court for compliance.
Trial Court is directed to forward the surrender report of the appellant no.1 to this Court.
With the aforesaid, the present application (I.A. No.7963/2025) is disposed off.
Certified copy today.
(VINAY SARAF) (PAVAN K
V. JUDGE
